The boundaries between the fruit and the ice cream are somewhat soft and indistinct, lacking the crisp edge definition expected in a macro food photograph. The powdered sugar appears as vague white blobs rather than distinct granules.
The structure of the pastry bowl is ambiguous. The layers of the pastry seem to merge into the background plate without clear separation, and the geometry of the rim is slightly irregular and warped.

The background green leaves are heavily blurred. While this may be intentional depth-of-field, the transition is overly smooth and lacks the natural bokeh characteristics of a lens, appearing more like a Gaussian blur applied digitally.
